labels.notes: A verbatim hoist with no statement change. Environment check, done independently of /tmp/hlev's dumps. HEAD's six affected modules (LemmaKSC, LemmaKObstruction, LevinUtility from `git show HEAD:`, and the unchanged LemmaKLocal, LemmaKSCLocal, LemmaK) were compiled from /tmp copies under their real names (lean --root, -DwarningAsError=true) into a /tmp mirror of the other Causal oleans, with Causal.LevinTimeFunction left out of it. In the working tree no other lean-causal file differs from HEAD, and HEAD's lean-causal is the closer's base 329dda5 (git diff 329dda5 HEAD -- lean-causal is empty). One Lean process imported `Causal` twice, once over the HEAD mirror and once over .lake, and compared every constant whose module is under Causal by structural Expr equality (Expr.==) of type and value, kind, universe parameters, inductive, constructor and recursor data, reducibility, protected and noncomputable. A second pass compared types binder by binder, with binder info and binder names, macro scopes erased. Result: HEAD 14350 Causal constants, working tree 14351. Removed 0. Added 1, Causal.Causality.GloballyHyperbolic.hasTimeFunction (thm, [u]). Changed in module only: exactly 38. 35 came from Causal.LevinUtility: the 18 Levin.* declarations, the 13 generated constants of Levin.Good, the matcher Levin.isUp_upHull.match_1_1, and exists_timeFunction_of_secondCountable, curvesExtend_of_secondCountable, exists_inextensible_of_secondCountable. 2 had been attributed to Causal.LemmaKSC (locallyCompactSpace_of_globallyHyperbolic, sigmaCompactSpace_of_globallyHyperbolic) and 1 to Causal.LemmaKObstruction (weaklyLocallyCompactSpace_of_globallyHyperbolic). All 38 are now in Causal.LevinTimeFunction. Any other change: 0, in both passes. Closure-level runs agree with the REPORT. Causal.LemmaKSC: removed 0, 37 added (moved constants this closure did not contain before, plus the wrapper), 1 module-only, 1 value change (the merged duplicate, below). Causal.LemmaKObstruction: removed 0, 37 added, 2 module-only, 0 type or value changes. Causal.LevinUtility: removed 0, 2 added (the wrapper and weaklyLocallyCompactSpace_of_globallyHyperbolic), 36 module-only, 1 value change (the duplicate). Text: each claimed range was cut from the HEAD copies and compared line for line. LevinUtility HEAD :75-454 = LevinTimeFunction :86-465 (380 lines). LemmaKObstruction HEAD :264-280 = :473-489. LemmaKSC HEAD :129-133 = :491-495. LevinUtility HEAD :456 = :497. LevinUtility HEAD :464-493 = :499-528. The kept corollaries, LevinUtility HEAD :495-522, = LevinUtility :72-99. All are byte-identical, and each occurs exactly once across the four files. LemmaKSC's deleted copy (HEAD :120-127) occurs nowhere. The prelude between the blocks (variable {M : Type u} [TopologicalSpace M], namespace Causality, variable {C : Causality M}) is HEAD LevinUtility :458-462's. Line counts as reported: 542 / 99 / 414 / 288, from 522 / 421 / 300. No label is marked. The only ``**`…`**`` in the four files is the declaration docstring of curvesExtend_of_secondCountable (LevinTimeFunction:512, HEAD text), which names a Lean declaration, not a label.

labels.label: T-abs-hoist-levin/duplicate
labels.notes: A probe loaded HEAD's closures separately. Causal.Causality.locallyCompactSpace_of_globallyHyperbolic in HEAD's LemmaKSC closure and in HEAD's LemmaKObstruction closure: types equal under Expr.== (hash 3324761659 both), universe lists [u] = [u], values different (2586026344 vs 3386744771, the REPORT's figures). HEAD root: the module index is Causal.LemmaKSC (moduleNames idx 4993, before LemmaKObstruction's 5000), and the value is LemmaKObstruction's copy, not LemmaKSC's. Working-tree root: the module is Causal.LevinTimeFunction, the type equals HEAD's, and the value equals HEAD's root value and LemmaKObstruction's copy. So the root's proof term is unchanged. In the working-tree LemmaKSC closure the value is now LemmaKObstruction's copy: that is the one disclosed value change of the merge. The surviving text is LemmaKObstruction HEAD :264-280 verbatim, with its helper weaklyLocallyCompactSpace_of_globallyHyperbolic. The closer's finding holds. Causal.lean imports Causal.LemmaKSC (:63) and Causal.LemmaKObstruction (:64), and the HEAD root imported both (my HEAD-mirror import of `Causal` succeeded). Toolchain source: ~/.elan/toolchains/leanprover--lean4---v4.31.0/src/lean/Lean/Environment.lean. The subsumesInfo docstring is at :2183-2202 ('We allow different modules to prove the same theorem'; 'we do not check whether the theorem `value` field match') and the def at :2203. It compares name, type (==), levelParams and `all`. finalizeImport (:2267-2279) inserts the later module's ConstantInfo when it subsumes the earlier one, and keeps the first module in const2ModIdx (insertIfNew). The target's evidence sentence 'no module imports both' was therefore false, as the REPORT says.

labels.label: T-abs-hoist-levin/wrapper
labels.notes: Causal/LevinTimeFunction.lean:535. Elaborated: ∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : TopologicalSpace M] {C : Causal.Causality M} [T2Space M] [SecondCountableTopology M], C.GloballyHyperbolic → C.Tarentin → C.HasTimeFunction. A probe theorem with the dispatch's statement written out has a type equal under Expr.== to the wrapper's, with the same level list [u]. The type uses exactly the constants TopologicalSpace, Causal.Causality, T2Space, SecondCountableTopology, Causal.Causality.GloballyHyperbolic, Causal.Causality.Tarentin and Causal.Causality.HasTimeFunction. HasTimeFunction is declared in Causal.CurvesExtend (:516: ∃ T, Continuous T ∧ ∀ x y, C.le ⊤ x y → x ≠ y → T x < T y). GloballyHyperbolic and Tarentin are declared in Causal.Properties (:144, :116). The only standing classes beyond the section's [TopologicalSpace M] are [T2Space M] [SecondCountableTopology M], the ladder edge's standing (programme/ladder.toml:584). #print axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound], the same as for exists_timeFunction_of_secondCountable. The module has 39 constants (38 moved plus the wrapper), so the tactic proof adds no auxiliary constant. Reading, as the SCOPE says: HasTimeFunction is not defi:fonction_temps (ETT.tex:1028), and no paper label is claimed.

build.details: Run from lean-causal/. `taskset -c 0-11 lake env lean -DwarningAsError=true` on Causal/LevinTimeFunction.lean, Causal/LevinUtility.lean, Causal/LemmaKSC.lean and Causal/LemmaKObstruction.lean gave exit 0 and no output for each. `lake build --no-build Causal` reported 'All targets up-to-date (8805 jobs)', and nothing was rebuilt. Exactly 8 oleans are newer than the closer's 'before' dump: LevinTimeFunction, LevinUtility, LemmaKSC, LemmaKObstruction, LemmaKLocal, LemmaKSCLocal, LemmaK and the root, as reported. scaffold/CausalScaffold/LemmaKSCOpen.lean typechecks with `lake env lean`; its one sorry is the existing one at :72. scripts/sorry_count.py: strict 0 in 246 files, scaffold 5 in 6. In the four files `sorry` occurs only in docstrings, and there is no admit, axiom or native_decide. collectAxioms over all 39 constants of Causal.LevinTimeFunction found nothing beyond propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. Layer 1. The new module's imports are exactly Causal.CurvesExtend, Causal.GlobalHyperbolicity and Mathlib.Topology.Compactness.Paracompact. Its compiled closure (header.moduleNames of a probe) has 23 Causal modules, the REPORT's list: none is Minkowski, Static, SingularFlat, Flat.*, Model.*, Port.*, CBG*, Splitting, LemmaK* or LevinUtility. tools/ladder.py model_path('Causal.LevinTimeFunction') is None. LevinUtility, LemmaKSC and LemmaKObstruction still reach Causal.Model.CurvesExtendModels through LemmaKReduction and LemmaKBare. The ETT layer was recounted with ladder.py's index, using HEAD's import lines for the three edited files: 66 of 245 before, 67 of 246 after, added Causal.LevinTimeFunction, lost none. No statement mentions a metric notion on the spacetime. The only metric-named constants in the module's 39 types are Real.pseudoMetricSpace and PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace, which are ℝ's own topology for `Continuous τ`, as at HEAD. The mathlib import was tested: the module was recompiled in /tmp without Mathlib.Topology.Compactness.Paracompact. Then exists_timeFunction_of_secondCountable has the same type as at HEAD and a different proof term. With the import, every moved constant's type and value equal HEAD's, the duplicate excepted. So the import exists only to keep the proof term identical, as the docstring says. Integration, simulated in /tmp with tools/ladder.py's own emitted/emit_lean/emit_test, on programme/ladder.toml as it stands and on a copy with the edge's witness switched to the wrapper. Both give 21 rules and 1 skipped edge (le_nested ⇒ curve_nested, sort). Neither output equals the on-disk Rules.lean or Test.lean. `pytest tests/test_programme.py -k test_shipped_rules_and_tests_are_generated` FAILS on the working tree now, as the REPORT warns. Each Rules+Test pair was concatenated into one file and compiled with `lake env lean -DwarningAsError=true`. With the old witness it fails on exactly 2 examples, GH ∧ tarentin ⊢ HasTimeFunction and ⊢ CurvesExtend under [T2Space M] [SecondCountableTopology M] (aesop exhaustive search failed). With the wrapper it compiles with no output. The switched Test has 347 examples: 38 derived and 309 not derived, against 36 and 305 on disk. The Rules diff is `import Causal.LevinTimeFunction`, one `attribute [aesop safe forward …] GloballyHyperbolic.hasTimeFunction`, and the removal of the skip comment. No papers/*/certificate/*.toml or papers/*/ledger/ledger.toml names LevinUtility, LemmaKSC, LemmaKObstruction or a moved declaration. `ledger.py check` exits 0 for ett, barbot, sbierski-mghd and ers-predictability, `ladder.py check` and `binder.py check` are green, and git status was identical before and after these runs.
